Name: Bigger House Renovations with Connecting Halls
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Expands renovations and cellar. Adds options halls between:
larger attic to larger corner room,
larger dining room to upper left room (default true)
larger southern room to larger cubby.

To change between connecting hall and no connecting hall. Make the selection and sleep. It will change during the night.
If you build the larger corner room and then the attic with hall you will not have to do this.
If you build the larger cubby and then the southern room with hall you will not have to do this.

I hope you enjoy this mod and take a look at my others including (used in pictures)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33552]NPC Portraits_Pictures
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31762]Barn and Coop Animal Plushies

[/url]
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/sadnumbme?gameId=1303]sadnumbme

[/url]Separate file for when using Hallway fix.  Instead of the hall off the dining room, use the bonus room from HallWay fix. The attic cannot use the hall between it and the corner and expanded corner room. Both the corner and expanded corner room are not able to be adjusted.  For the southern room, do not select a nook in Hallway fix.
